leads.name: Rela Marché Africain
leads.web: No store website found; Facebook + TikTok
leads.reason: Opened a new branch at 5815 boul. Léger, Montréal-Nord, announced Nov 2025 on their TikTok. Now 3-4 locations and no online store found. One online store could serve every branch.
leads.contact: Unknown. Ask for the owner at the Décarie store, or message the Facebook page
leads.src: TikTok @rela_marche_africain (Nov 2025); Tripadvisor; sagafrika.ca branch list; Facebook

leads.name: Marché du Mboa
leads.reason: Rela opened a new store on the same street (5815 Léger) in Nov 2025. Online ordering and delivery would help Mboa keep its regular customers.

leads.name: Petite Afrique
leads.reason: A grocery and West African restaurant. Their site gives 2026 as the founding year, so they are a new business that may still be building its sales channels. The pitch is to put the grocery side online.
leads.contact: Unknown. Use the contact form on their site

leads.name: Marché Mokolo
leads.reason: Cameroonian grocery open since 2009 in Côte-des-Neiges, a dense area. Its online presence is split across three Facebook pages and it has no website. It's the kind of established store that is easy to pitch.
leads.contact: Unknown. Store phone; an email is listed on Facebook

leads.name: Épicerie Africaine de Montréal
leads.reason: Long-standing store with a phone listing and no website or online ordering found.

leads.name: Continent Africain
leads.reason: Draws loyal customers from Longueuil and Montréal. Three African grocers are on Chemin de Chambly, and Marché Gouroh already sells online on the South Shore. The first of them to go online gets the street's delivery customers.

leads.name: Elikya Rive Sud
leads.reason: African and Caribbean grocery on the same Chambly strip, with no website found. Same angle as Continent Africain.

leads.name: Ghanacan
leads.reason: African butcher and grocery. Its current site has only a simple shop page, so pitch an upgrade to a real online store with delivery.

leads.name: Marché Sabiraa
leads.reason: African, Antillean and Spanish products. Its only online presence is a nearly empty Facebook page.

leads.name: Marché Castel
leads.reason: Large North African grocery with a butcher, produce and a restaurant. It's a bigger operation than most on this list. Check that North African stores fit your offer.

leads.name: Marché LT Eben-Ezer
leads.reason: Congolese and African products. It has a website, but I couldn't confirm whether it takes orders. If it's brochure-only, it's a good fit.
leads.contact: Unknown. Use the contact on their site

leads.name: Épicerie Ebenezer
leads.reason: African, Caribbean, Haitian and Asian products. It has a site, but online ordering is not confirmed. Check before pitching.
